accurateCrosses.description: The number of crosses that find their target.

accurateLongBalls.description: The number of longballs that are completed.

accurateThroughBalls.description: The number of through balls that find their target.

appearances.description: The number of times a player has made an appearance in a match.

avgExpectedGoalDifferential.description: The average difference of average xG scored and average xG conceded.

avgExpectedGoalsConceded.description: Average number of Expected Goals Against

avgGoalDifferential.description: The average difference of goals scored and goals conceded.

avgGoalsConceded.description: The average number of goals allowed by the goalkeeper.

avgRatingFromCorrespondent.description: The rating from a correspondent for a player.

avgRatingFromDataFeed.description: The rating from the data feed for a player.

avgRatingFromEditor.description: The rating from the editor(s) for a player.

avgRatingFromUser.description: The average user rating for a player.

awayGoals.description: The number of away goals that team or player has scored

bigChanceCreated.description: A pass which led to a clear-cut scoring opportunity, such as a one-on-one situation or a shot from just a few yards out

bigChanceSaves.description: Count of major scoring chances saved by the player (usually goalkeepers)

blockedShots.description: The number shots blocked by a defender.

cleanSheet.description: The number of times a goalkeeper doesn't let in a goal.

crossPct.description: The percentage of crosses that find their target.

defensiveActions.description: Number of defensive moves made by the team in the defensive third

dnp.description: The number of times a player did not play in a match.

draws.description: The number of times the scored ended even for both teams in a match and there was no extra time.

duels.description: Total number of direct player-on-player confrontations for possession of the ball (aerial + ground duels)

duelsLost.description: Total number of duels over the possession of the ball where a player loses the ball - doesn't include 'overrun' situations where the attacking player takes on an opponent but the ball runs away from them out of play or to an opponent.

duelsWon.description: Total number of duels for possession of the ball where possession was won (aerial won + ground duels won)

effectiveClearance.description: The number of clearances that stops the attack of the opposing team.

effectiveTackles.description: The number of tackles where the player wins the ball.

foulsCommitted.description: The number of fouls comitted by a player or team.

foulsSuffered.description: The number of fouls suffered by a player or team.

freeKickGoals.description: The number goals scored from free kick shots.

freeKickShots.description: The number of free kick shots attempted.

gameWinningAssists.description: The number of game winning assists.

gameWinningGoals.description: The number of game winning goals.

goalConversion.description: Total number of goals divided by (Attempts on target + Attempts off target). Note: Blocked shots are not included in this calculation.

goalDifference.description: The difference of goals scored and goals conceded.

goalsConceded.description: The number of goals allowed by the goalkeeper.

handBalls.description: The number of handball fouls committed..

headedGoals.description: The number of goals scored from headers.

homeGoals.description: The number of home goals that team or player has scored

inaccurateCrosses.description: The number of times a cross was attempted and failed to find its target.

inaccurateLongBalls.description: The number of times a long ball was attempted and failed to be completed

inaccuratePasses.description: The number of times a pass was attempted and failed to find its target.

inaccurateThroughBalls.description: The number of times a through ball was attempted and failed to be completed.

inneffectiveTackles.description: The number of tackles where the player doesn't win the ball.

leftFootedShots.description: The number of shots attempted with a player's left foot.

longballPct.description: The percentage of long balls attempted that find their target.

losses.description: The number of times a team has lost a match.

lostCorners.description: The number of corners conceded to the opposing team.

minutes.description: The number of minutes played by a player.

offsides.description: The number of times a player or team gets caught offside.

ownGoals.description: The number of own goals conceded.

partialCleenSheet.description: The number of times a clean sheet is kept when playing at least a part of the game.

passPct.description: The percentage of passes that result in the ball finding its target.

penaltyGoalsConceded.description: Penalty goal conceded (and scored) against the team in question

penaltyKickConceded.description: The number of goals allowed when the opposing team take a penalty.

penaltyKickGoals.description: The number of goals scored from the penalty spot.

penaltyKickPct.description: The percentage of penalty kicks converted.

penaltyKickSavePct.description: The percentage of penalty kicks a goalkeeper saves.

penaltyKickShots.description: The number of penalty kicks attempted.

penaltyKicksFaced.description: The number of penalty kicks faced by a goalkeeper.

penaltyKicksMissed.description: The number of penalty kicks missed.

penaltyKicksSaved.description: The number of penalty kicks saved by a goalkeeper.

possessionPct.description: The percentage of the game this team had possession

recoveries.description: Total number of recoveries - when a player takes possession of a loose ball and successfully keeps possession for at least two passes or an attacking play

redCards.description: The number of red cards that have been issued.

rightFootedShots.description: The number of shots attempted with the right foot.

savePct.description: The percentage of shots on target that are saved by a goalkeeper.

saves.description: The number of times a goalkeeper makes a save.

shootOutGoals.description: The number of penalty kicks converted in penalty shootouts.

shootOutKicksFaced.description: The number of penalty kicks faced in a penalty shootout.

shootOutKicksSaved.description: The number of penalty kicks saved in a penalty shootout.

shootOutMisses.description: The number of penalty kicks missed in penalty shootouts.

shootOutPct.description: The percentage of penalty kicks in a penalty shootout that are converted.

shootOutSavePct.description: The percentage of penalty kicks saved in a penalty shootout.

shotAssists.description: The number of passes that directly result in a shot.

shotPct.description: The percentage of shots that are on target.

shotsFaced.description: The number of shots on target a goalkeeper has faced.

shotsHeaded.description: The number of shots attempted with the head.

shotsOffTarget.description: The number shots attempted that miss the goal.

shotsOnPost.description: The number of shots that hit the post.

shotsOnTarget.description: The number of shots that are on goal.

starts.description: The number of starts a player has made in matches.

subIns.description: The number of times a player has come on a sub in a match.

subOuts.description: The number of times a player has been subbed off in a match.

suspensions.description: The number of matches a player has been suspended.

tacklePct.description: The perencentage of tackles where the player wins the ball.

throughBallPct.description: The percentage of through balls played that find their target.

timesTackled.description: The total number of times a player has been tackled.

totalGoals.description: The number of goals scored against the opposing team.

totalLongBalls.description: The number of long balls attempted.

totalThroughBalls.description: The number of through balls attempted.

unclaimedCrosses.description: The number of crosses that were unclaimed.

yellowCards.description: The number of yellow cards accumulated.
